protocol.laplace_number_definition: La = rho*gamma*lambda/mu^2 (Popinet 2009, section 5.3); Oh = 1/sqrt(La) = 0.0183, epsilon = nu*k^2/omega0 = 0.0458
protocol.time_step: dt <= sqrt(rho*h^3/(4*pi*gamma)) = (1/sqrt(2)) * sqrt(rho*h^3/(2*pi*gamma)), rounded down so that the run is 100 equal output intervals; dt_divisor 2 and 4 are the temporal refinement runs
protocol.reference: Prosperetti initial-value solution for a free surface (Phys. Fluids 19, 195 (1976); Phys. Fluids 24, 1217 (1981), one-fluid limit), fitted with the same damped-cosine model on the same output times as the simulation
protocol.note: Criteria apply separately to each (capillary form, Laplace number, time-step divisor) refinement study; the protocol study uses divisor 1. See README.md for the definitions and the cost of each level.

criteria.definition: |omega_sim - omega_ref| / omega_ref. omega_sim is the angular frequency of the least-squares fit exp(-beta t)(c1 cos(omega t) + c2 sin(omega t)) to the cos(kx) mode amplitude a_h(t) over all outputs including t = 0; omega_ref is the same fit to Prosperetti's a(t) sampled at the same times.
criteria.order_method: least-squares slope of log(error) against log(lambda/h) over order_levels; pairwise orders are reported
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (tracker section 5, M3: frequency error <= 2% at lambda/h = 32, with convergence over 16/32/64). First order is the rate expected for the force on a piecewise-planar interface (Gross and Reusken 2011, ch. 7), as for the static-drop pressure jump.

criteria.definition: |beta_sim - beta_ref| / beta_ref with beta the amplitude decay rate of the same two fits.
criteria.order_method: least-squares slope of log(error) against log(lambda/h) over order_levels; pairwise orders are reported
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (tracker section 5, M3: damping error <= 5% at lambda/h = 32, with convergence over 16/32/64).

criteria.definition: max over all outputs of |A(t) - A(0)| / A(0), with A the exact area of {phi_h < 0} and A(0) that of the sampled initial level set in mesh/mesh-complete.mesh.vtu
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (tracker section 5: volume drift <= 1e-4, as for M1 and M2, applied to M3). A(0) includes the whole liquid layer (depth ~ lambda); mean_level_drift_over_amplitude reports the same drift relative to a0.
